name: Lineup
description: Lineup provides a web dashboard for HDHomeRun discovery and proxying, live TV streaming, scheduled EPG collection, and XMLTV output for media servers such as Jellyfin and Plex. BREAKING 2.0 HOST LAYOUT: before starting Lineup 2.0, existing users must move or copy the contents of their prior Lineup appdata directory (whether its container target was /config or /appdata) into /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data, or explicitly change this template's Appdata host path to retain their existing directory. Otherwise, Lineup starts as a new installation. HTTPS certificates remain separate under /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/certs and must not be moved into the data directory.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Lineup settings, database, and other application-owned state. BREAKING 2.0 MIGRATION: before starting 2.0, move or copy the contents of your prior Lineup appdata directory (whether previously mapped to /config or /appdata) into /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data, or explicitly retain your existing host path here. Otherwise, Lineup starts as a new installation. Keep HTTPS certificates in the separate certificate directory; do not move them into this data directory.

paths.name: XMLTV Output
paths.description: Host path where Lineup stores generated XMLTV output.

paths.name: HTTPS Certificate Directory
paths.description: Host directory containing the HTTPS certificate named lineup.pfx. The certificate is available in the container at /app/certs/lineup.pfx.

ports.name: Web Interface (HTTP)
ports.description: Host port mapped to Lineup's HTTP listener on TCP port 8080.

ports.name: Web Interface (HTTPS)
ports.description: Optional host port mapped to Lineup's HTTPS listener on TCP port 8443. HTTPS must be configured in Lineup.

ports.name: HDHomeRun Discovery / Proxy
ports.description: Optional UDP port used for HDHomeRun discovery and proxy traffic.

ports.name: SSDP Discovery
ports.description: Optional UDP port used for SSDP discovery traffic.

variables.name: HTTPS Certificate Password
variables.description: Optional password for lineup.pfx. Leave blank when using a passwordless PFX certificate.

variables.name: OpenTelemetry Endpoint
variables.description: Optional OTLP endpoint. Leave blank to disable OpenTelemetry export.

variables.name: OpenTelemetry Protocol
variables.description: OTLP transport protocol. Supported values are httpProtobuf and grpc.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID for the running container

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the running container
